Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Karan - 34 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Pallavi - 64 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Manoj - 34 years, friend
Look: glasses, brown sweater
4. Shalini - 29 years, friend
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
5. Meenakshi - 32 years, daughter
Look: pink kurta, a long plait

Places

1. The fields - a wheat crop, a neem tree

Scene 1: The fields - Day

[Karan stands in the fields. Pallavi and Manoj stand near him.]

Karan: "What lovely weather!"

[Karan ploughs the field.]

Pallavi: "Show me too!"

[Karan rests under the tree in the shade.]

Karan: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
